name: Blame
overview: Scripture reveals that blame often arises from human folly and a heart opposed to God, as seen when Adam shifted responsibility onto Eve after sinning (Genesis 3:12) and Proverbs highlights how foolishness leads one to fret against the Lord. Jesus warns against judging others to avoid being judged ourselves (Matthew 7:1), emphasizing God's desire not to condemn but to save through Christ (John 3:17). The root of deceit and blame is linked to the devil, described as the father of lies who opposes truth (John 8:44). Despite the trials believers face, Christ assures us of peace and victory over the world’s tribulations (John 16:33).
